tools.name: lookup_creator
tools.description: Find a creator's accounts on the other platforms from one Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or X profile URL. Returns the creator, each account with its verdict, net confidence (0–1) and evidence, and any websites. 1 credit when at least one account is found; free otherwise.

tools.name: check_balance
tools.description: Credits left on the account behind the API key. Free.

tools.name: start_batch
tools.description: Queue up to 500 profile URLs to look up in the background. Returns a batch id; poll it with get_batch. Each row is charged only if it finds accounts.

tools.name: get_batch
tools.description: Progress and the rows found so far for a batch started with start_batch.
